text:
maya: Quick heads-up  Zane's birthday next Wed. thinking tiny office "fiesta" lunch (chips + salsa + mini cake) or just mini cake + coffee. who's in? :taco: :cake:
sam: in for fiesta if facilities okay with food.
lina: mini cake + coffee is safer (allergies). can we quick poll?
people-ops-bot: Poll posted: react to vote: :one: Fiesta lunch (chips/salsa + mini cake)  :two: Mini cake + coffee only
noah: :one: for fiesta 83 also ok with cake only if allergy concerns.
zane: (reading but be surprised!!) haha i will be thrilled with either.
jordan: :two: cake + coffee. i'll bring decaf.
maya: note  if fiesta wins we'll avoid nuts and bring individually wrapped chips + yogurt cups for sensitivity.
people-ops-bot: Team budget available: $45. Collection link if we go over: https://pay.example.com/zane-bday (suggested $5)
lina: RSVP yes for in-person setup at 11:30. i'll handle plates/napkins.
sam: can remote folks send 10s shoutouts? i'll stitch into a 30s clip. clips due Tue EOD.
remind-bot: Reminder set: "Zane clips due" Tue 5pm.
noah: i'll chip $5.
jordan: also thinking a tiny desk prop (pinata keychain?) silent and silly. yay or nay?
maya: yes, if it's small and not noisy.
zane: please no full-size pif1ata lol :joy: but tiny keychain is perfect.
people-ops-bot: Poll closes Mon 4pm. Event created: "Zane birthday: mini fiesta or cake" Wed 12:00-12:30 Kitchen + Zoom. Invite sent.
maya: final ask  keep it secret! zane lurks here. :shushing_face:
zane: (again reading) you are all the worst in the best way :heart:
(End of thread)
